claims.statement: Tom Allen beat J. C. Gallagher on a small island near the arsenal when the sponge was thrown up before the 17th round.
claims.excerpt: was thrown up for Gallagher, and Allen was declared

claims.statement: The fight was arranged in secret so the police would not be told, and was held early in the morning.
claims.excerpt: police were kept ignorant of the proposed action.

claims.statement: Barney Aaron and George Collins seconded Allen.
claims.excerpt: for seconds, Barney Aaron ald Geo. Collins, and was

claims.statement: Allen gave $50 of the $100 subscribed for Gallagher after the fight.
claims.excerpt: $100 collected, $50 of which was given by Allen.
